title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.
llm_summary: LangChain, the AI‑agent startup behind the model‑agnostic LangSmith platform, says it now serves roughly 7,000 customers. The rapid adoption helped push the company’s valuation to about $3 billion, underscoring growing demand for tools that simplify building and managing AI agents across different models.
